column1: # v1.1 anchor detection: Pfam OR CONJScan, with the SAME conjunct on both sides.
# CURATED. Generated scripts must not write here (A9).
# RULE (user-stated, v1.1): a disjunction is admissible only if the added side
# carries the IDENTICAL conjunct as the Pfam side. A disjunction whose two arms
# have different conjuncts is not a detector, it is two detectors with a union
# taken over incomparable sets.
# A row is only added after BOTH controls pass on the new admissions:
#   length band   >=80% inside the anchor's own robust band (Q1-1.5IQR, Q3+1.5IQR)
#                 measured from the PFAM hits, never assumed or transferred
#   cross-class   <10% of new plasmids also admitted by the MPF_F entry criterion
# The retracted phmmer recall failed exactly these: VirB5's "recovered" proteins
# were median 816 aa against a 238 aa family, 85.6% already assigned elsewhere.
# conjunct is the anchor's OWN. VirB5's aa>150 is NOT transferred to other rows:
# VirB2 is a pilin whose mature form is ~70-100 aa and aa>150 would delete it.
# status: ACTIVE     used by the v1.1 builder
#         TESTED_NO  measured, controls failed or no material gain, kept as record
#         PENDING    not yet measured
